ai4science.scope: Only Agents’ Last Exam, FrontierPhysics and RSI-Exam, following user restriction. No MolP2SBench or RSI for Science logos collected or proposed.

projects.evidence: Official homepage navbar img has alt="Agents' Last Exam logo"; its Next.js optimized-image URL names /media/brand/agenthle-logo.jpg as the source. Downloaded that exact original public resource.
projects.visual_judgment: Dark grey circular A-shaped brand mark with transparent background, matching the homepage logo; not a partner institution or framework icon.
projects.format_note: Publisher resource has a .jpg extension and image/jpeg HTTP header but its actual bytes are PNG RGBA. Selected .png file is a byte-identical copy; no recompression or redraw.

projects.evidence: Official page declares this SVG as rel=icon. Its circle, arc and triangular ruler path data match the inline SVG in the homepage navigation link to /frontierphysics.
projects.visual_judgment: An orbital circular arc and dot surrounding a triangular measuring/ruler mark. The exact graphic is used for the project navbar; not the separate BenchFlow partner logo or a generic Next.js favicon.
projects.theme_note: The original favicon includes prefers-color-scheme rules: near-black on light system theme, near-white on dark. A fixed white image box could therefore hide it in OS dark mode. Alternative is the exact official navbar SVG with currentColor, suitable for inline use with the website theme; do not assume external img currentColor inherits the parent.

alternatives.extraction: Copied the original navbar SVG and only added the standard SVG XML namespace for standalone validity. No path/color geometry changes.

alternatives.judgment: White same mark on an opaque near-black background.

projects.evidence: Official page rel=apple-touch-icon points to this asset. Official stylesheet .brand::before uses an embedded PNG of the same mark, establishing that it is the visible site brand symbol.
projects.visual_judgment: Rose-and-dark ribbon/loop mark on a transparent background. Visually verified against the actual 96×96 .brand::before PNG extracted from the official CSS. Not an institution seal or framework icon.

alternative.extraction: Decoded the exact data:image/png;base64 payload from .brand::before; no redraw or alteration.

presentation: PARSEC and PySCF original assets are displayed through CSS viewports showing their graphic marks. DTCS uses the group homepage background at its original aspect ratio.
